title: Basic training
notes: A new save asks if you want the tutorial: a drill at Site 9, a small military research facility. Each control gets a short note and a caution-tape box, and the fight stops while you read.
Tutorial notes can be dragged out of the way. Each new note comes back in the middle.
A new eye button at the top middle hides the controls along the bottom so you can see the street.
The drill ends with a horde nobody can hold. Losing is part of the job.
The war board points out its buttons the first time you open it.
Screen changes on a phone no longer flash black and show the old screen again before the new one.
Playing as a soldier, he now always fires on his own. Your finger or the mouse only aims.
